metadata.title: Ordenanza Ministerial N° 798/014, Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (Ministerio de Salud Pública), with annex
metadata.edition: Dated 12/12/2014; replaced by Ordenanza 23/025 on 13 January 2025 · industry: fatal or mass-risk 24 hours, serious already described in the literature 48 hours, others 15 días hábiles (gub.uy trámites OCR copy; the MSP normativa PDF has no text layer) (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: Ordenanza of the Ministerio de Salud Pública; the official Spanish text governs.
